# Hackways

> Hackways is an event and community platform for discovering technology gatherings, hosting events and managing registrations.

Hackways connects people with hackathons, meetups, conferences and other technology events. A Space is a community profile with its events. Each event has its own registration and participation requirements, described on its current public page.

## Explore the platform

- [About Hackways](https://hackways.in/about): What the platform does and how attending and hosting work.
- [Discover events](https://hackways.in/discover): Current publicly listed events and their registration details.
- [Spaces](https://hackways.in/spaces): Community profiles and their events.
- [Programs](https://hackways.in/programs): Published programs and role details. Current availability and requirements are shown on each program page.
- [Hackways Ambassadors](https://hackways.in/ambassadors): An introduction to bringing a community together through events hosted on Hackways.

## Help and hosting

- [Organizer guide](https://hackways.in/organizers): Preparing, publishing and managing an event.
- [Finding an event](https://hackways.in/help/finding): Discovery, visibility and schedules.
- [Registration and status](https://hackways.in/help/joining): Confirmation, organizer review and waiting lists.
- [Your registration](https://hackways.in/help/changes): Tickets and available registration actions.
- [Accounts and email](https://hackways.in/help/accounts): Sign-in, verification and transactional email.
- [Hosting an event](https://hackways.in/help/hosting): Event settings and the organizer workspace.
- [Safety and support](https://hackways.in/help/safety): Getting help and protecting private information.
- [Contact](https://hackways.in/contact): Platform support and event-specific contacts.

## AI workspace connection

- [Hackways MCP](https://hackways.in/mcp): Connecting a Hackways account to an AI workspace.
- [MCP setup](https://hackways.in/mcp/setup): Authentication and connection instructions.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://hackways.in/privacy): Information use and access.
- [Terms](https://hackways.in/terms): Responsibilities when using the platform.
- [Acceptable use](https://hackways.in/acceptable-use): Participation, content and conduct guidelines.
- [Sitemap](https://hackways.in/sitemap.xml): Public page discovery.

Event and program information can change. Their current public pages are the source for schedules, availability and participation requirements. Account records, guest lists, application answers and decisions are private; they are not part of this public directory.
